spec.assertion: Structural disjunction — if encoded it must be trigger hitCount{count:5}, target enemy, negative value, durationSec 5; otherwise the verbatim line must appear in unmodeled.skill1. Hard invariants: zero damageTakenPct effects anywhere in the kit and zero ally-facing ATK effects. Fails under the nearest-wrong models: re-badging the boss debuff as damageTakenPct (inflates the whole team), sign flip onto allies, or a silent drop. Direct verification of the boss-side payload is it.skip (no enemy entity in v1).

spec.kitLine: FB end + same-squad ally: burst CD -20.16s
spec.assertion: Structural: exactly one burstCdr effect, trigger.kind fullBurstEnd, target self, teamHas.sameSquad true, seconds 20.16, oncePerBattle falsy, everyN 1. Behavioural (directional, because ram is a Burst I sharing stage 1 with liter and may not be the selected caster): fullBurstStart count base >= CDR-removed, and gate-removed >= base. Fails under fullBurstEnter/burstCast keying, an allies target (team-wide CDR), a dropped sameSquad gate, a once-per-battle limiter, or a wrong magnitude.

spec.kitLine: self Max HP up 40.72%, 10 sec, no heal
spec.assertion: Structural: one skill2 block, target self, stat targetMaxHpPct or maxHpPct at 40.72, durationSec 10, no durationShots (seconds, not rounds). Behavioural: maxHpFlat buffApply events targeting ram exist and drop when the effect is removed (proves the events are hers); re-targeting the block to allies strictly increases maxHpFlat events on non-ram slugs (proves self scope). Inertness: removing it leaves the whole totals map byte-identical — RED if Max HP is routed into ATK via atkOfMaxHpPct. TRIGGER CADENCE IS FLAGGED: the line has no activation clause, so its interval/skill-cooldown period is not in the kit text and is not asserted.

No StatKey expresses 'percent of the skill user's DEF' and defPct is inert in v1, so the assertion is a disjunction: encoded with target alliesLowestHp{count:2} and durationSec 5, or recorded verbatim in unmodeled.skill2. Hard: no ATK-flavoured effect at 11.34 anywhere. Inertness: removing it leaves totals byte-identical — RED if the DEF grant was approximated with a live offensive stat.

spec.kitLine: all allies: shield 10.08% of user Max HP
spec.assertion: Structural: one burst block, trigger burstCast, target allies with excludeSelf falsy ('all allies' includes ram), shield effect maxHpPct 10.08, durationSec 10, and NO damage effect in the burst slot (her burst deals no damage). Behavioural: removing the shield leaves ram's own total and the full totals map unchanged, documenting that the line is tandem-only in this comp. Fails under an invented burst damage rider, excludeSelf, a wrong percentage, or a self-only scope.

fixtures: controlComp('ram', true) only — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / ram / helm (B3), 7 hoisted 180s runs (base + 6 withPatchedOverride counterfactuals: CDR effect removed, CDR squad gate removed, Max HP removed, Max HP re-targeted to allies, DEF removed, shield removed). The fixed B3 is mandatory: skill1-b keys off Full Burst END, which needs a completed I->II->III chain, and a lone Burst I would never produce one. Two structural caveats drove the design: (1) ram is herself Burst I and therefore competes with liter for stage 1, so she is not guaranteed to cast — every rotation claim is written as a monotone inequality and the trigger/gate/magnitude identity is pinned structurally off the override clone instead; (2) her squadmates are not in the control comp, so the sameSquad gate is expected to be UNSATISFIED here, which is exactly why 'gate removed >= base' is the discriminating direction.
gaps: it.skip — skill1-a boss-side ATK reduction: v1 models no enemy entity, no boss ATK and no incoming player damage, so the payload has no observable channel; only its absence from the ally side is testable.

it.skip — burst shield application: cfg.onEvent exposes no shield event kind and no unit in controlComp carries a shielded trigger or requiresShielded gate, so 'reaches all four allies' cannot be observed; asserted structurally plus damage-inertness instead.

NOT ASSERTED (flagged, outside the input domain): skill2's activation cadence. Both skill2 lines carry no activation clause, so their interval/skill-cooldown period is a datamined value absent from the kit prose; the tests pin scope, magnitude, duration and target set but never the firing period.
NOT ASSERTED: the Max HP buff's exact flat value (40.72% of ram's base Max HP) — base HP is not in the packet, so the events are matched by stat and target rather than by magnitude.
